nodes.label: Reasoner Core Python Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Core Python dependencies including FastAPI, uvicorn, anthropic, openai, google-genai, httpx, supabase, PyJWT, redis, stripe, pydantic, pypdf, python-docx, pymupdf, simpleeval, yfinance, lxml, asyncpg, aiosqlite, alembic, sqlalchemy, psutil, cryptography, pytest. Python 3.10+ required.
